notes: The call log undocks into its own window — and it opens with what tinyjs.json declared, read back at boot: version, window size, url scheme, file types, the permissions this app asks for. Secondary windows (the undocked log, the inspector) now follow the deck's light/dark instead of being stuck in dark.

win.notes:
The call log undocks into its own window — and it opens with what tinyjs.json declared, read back at boot: version, window size, url scheme, file types, the permissions this app asks for. Secondary windows (the undocked log, the inspector) now follow the deck's light/dark instead of being stuck in dark.

Frameless demo windows no longer draw a sliver of macOS titlebar along their top edge. Rebuilt on tinyjs 0.39.1.
